overview: A boutique hotel on the clifftop between Bude and Widemouth Bay, with rooms looking over the sea or the countryside. It has a restaurant and bar and offers beauty treatments. Dogs can come too, and the coast path runs nearby.
surfTripFit: It sits between Summerleaze and Widemouth, a short drive to whichever beach is working best.
